pairs.question: Numquid recte possumus dicere: 'Iste musicus nouit quidem musicam sed nunc eam non intellegit quia non eam cogitat; intellegit autem nunc geometricam, hanc enim nunc cogitat'?
pairs.answer: Absurda est quantum apparet ista sententia.
pairs.derivation: Augustine poses a 'numquid' question (expecting 'no') and answers it himself in the next sentence with a flat declarative. Dropped the leading connective 'Sed' as presentation normalization (capitalizing 'Numquid'). The answer is the whole first sentence of the reply, ending at 'ista sententia.'; what follows ('Quid etiam illa si dicamus...') turns to a new parallel question and is excluded. The parallel case immediately after is answered only by another rhetorical question ('Nonne similiter absurda est?'), so it was dropped to keep precision.
